source_evidence: Employers such as public educational institutions (public schools, colleges, and universities), certain non-profits, and churches or church-related organizations may offer 403(b) plans. Employers such as state and local government agencies and certain non-profit organizations may offer 457(b) plans.
answer: Employer eligibility differs between the plans. Public schools, colleges, universities, certain nonprofits, and churches or church-related organizations may offer 403(b) plans. State and local government agencies and certain nonprofits may offer 457(b) plans. Some employers may offer both, so check with your employer to learn which plans are available.
